name: Scroll 3D Object Explorer
description: A horizontal scroll-snap product explorer where every card carries a pure CSS 3D object (a cuboid box, a hologram cross of SVG planes, a hex tin) that spins 450 degrees as you scroll, driven entirely by named view timelines. Titles wipe in and out and captions fade up near the snap point. Zero JavaScript.
usage: Include styles.css, then add an .s3d-explorer scroller containing one .s3d-card per product; give each card an absolutely placed h2 title, a footer caption, and an .s3d-stage holding an .s3d-object in one of the three variants from index.html (s3d-box, s3d-planes, s3d-hex). Scroll the panel sideways and each object spins on its card's own view timeline.
